text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser loses to Nice Nature at 
the Arima Kinen. After the race, the place 
the two of them headed was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a ramen shop, Matikanetannhauser 
marveled with a groan at Nice Nature's 
growth as she looked back on the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to do her absolute best in the 
next race, she slurped down her noodles 
and prepared for the upcoming battle.
